score_semantics.quantity: Learned Pairwise Discourse Compatibility P(Antecedent -> Successor)
score_semantics.mathematical_formula: P(c_i -> c_j) = sigmoid(MLP([c_i, c_j, |c_i - c_j|, c_i * c_j]))
score_semantics.interpretation: Values close to 1.0 represent high model transition compatibility (normal sequential ordering); values close to 0.0 represent structural discontinuity / anomalous flow.
score_semantics.normalization_disclosure: Scores are independent pairwise binary classification likelihoods, not row-stochastic Markov transition probabilities. Row sums do NOT sum to 1.0.
